Name: Wedding Reception Portraits for RSV
Author: cptnmatruz
Description:
Ridgeside Village added new wedding and anniversary events, in which at the end it would show a portrait of your spouse, unfortunately this only includes RSV romanceables.

This mod now includes wedding portraits of the base game love interests (Abigail, Penny, Leah, Haley, Maru, Emily, Alex, Sam, Sebastian, Harvey, Elliott, and Shane), they will appear on Ridgeside Village's new wedding reception and anniversary events. It also includes matching variations if you are using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod.

[size=5][b]IMPORTANT:[/b][/size][size=5] [u]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] to work!!!![/u][/size]

To see the event (WARNING *spoilers*):
After Naomi returns to the village in year 2, she will open an event hall at the hotel. Just go and schedule a wedding or anniversary.

[size=4][b]To install:[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip in ../Stardew Valley/Mods
[/list]
[size=4][b]To add additional portraits for additional characters:[/b][/size]

1. Create a portrait PNG image of 144 * 112 px.
2. Name it [code]{Character's Internal Name}.png
[/code] (eg: if the character's internal name is "AuthorName.ModName.Alice" then the filename should be [code]AuthorName.ModName.Alice.png[/code])
3. Put the file in the mod's folder /Assets
4. For seasonal cute variants, add an additonal file named:
[code]{Character's Internal Name}_seasonal_cute.png
[/code]
[b][size=4]Credits:[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] created by Rafseazz.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] created by Poltergeister and various artists.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23321]RRRR[/url] addtional portrail by Milkawai

Also: Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's wedding portraits[/url] which you can use with this mod!
